sourceOfTruth.rule: Decompile installed NGO.Core.Services.dll and extract public/protected constructor, generic declaration, constraints, and overridden method signatures before patching.

knownBreakingChanges.rule: Confirm exact arity, position, and constraints from installed DLL before patching.
Patch constructor, base(...) call, DI registration, and direct construction sites together.

antiPatterns: Do not add private fields unless client code uses them.
Do not change override to new.

successCriteria: EntityService CS7036, CS0305, and CS0311 families are gone.
DI registration arity matches the compiled service contract.
